answer: Sybil resistance comes from stratified provenance, not staked capital: each agent bid carries a ledger of idiosyncratic settled trades, layered like shale, so duplicate identities start on bare rock. Payouts need a counterparty to countersign a fresh, non-replayable exchange, so forged twins burn real fees fabricating a past, while honest agents build a relic trail no cheap fork clones, leaving the counterfeit ridge thin and true sediment deep.
